title: Rationed Light

mood.label: Uneasy calm
mood.summary: Uneasy calm (41): tankers hit in Hormuz and Iran rationing power, strikes on Kryvyi Rih and Gaza, COP31 in a second overtime. Science carried the relief: a one-shot CRISPR cholesterol cut, a Riemann proof under scrutiny.

style.genre: motorik krautrock — dan tranh, balafon, chamber organ, Korg KR-55

lines: Tankers burning in the narrow strait,
Tehran counting out its hours of light,
Kryvyi Rih sweeping up the glass,
The climate room still will not close,
the peso slipping past a thousand,
thirty-six names in the factory smoke,
a cartel boss taken, eleven gone.
Keep the motor running, keep it low —
one shot halves what the heart can't hold,
someone checks a proof by the window,
uneasy, calm, and on we go.
